nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Tình huống khẩn · bài tự soạn
kind: Hội thoại nhờ người lạ gọi cấp cứu
L: Excuse me! Can you help? A man just fell off his bike.
Yes, but his leg really hurts and he can't stand up.
Don't move him. I'll call an ambulance right now.
Thank you. I'll stay with him and keep him calm.
Hello? We need an ambulance on Park Road, near the bridge.
Tell them he's awake and talking.
They say it'll take about eight minutes.
Sir, help is coming. Please stay still.
I'll wait by the road and wave when it arrives.

exq.why: “A man just fell off his bike.” = ông ấy vừa ngã xe đạp.
“his leg really hurts” = chân ông ấy rất đau.

exq.q: Where do they need the ambulance?
exq.a: On Park Road, near the bridge
exq.why: “on Park Road, near the bridge” = ở đường Park, gần cầu.

exq.q: How long will the ambulance take?
What will Dan do when the ambulance comes?
exq.why: “wait by the road and wave” = đứng chờ ven đường và vẫy tay.
